title: Picking Unassigned clears the Sales Representative field
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the Sales Representative field and look inside it for an x.
  2. Click the field and click "Unassigned".
  3. Reload the page and click the field.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is no x inside the field.
  • Step 2: the dropdown closes and the field reads "Unassigned".
  • Step 3: the field still reads "Unassigned" and "Unassigned" is the checked option.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-R10: “The field has no x inside it. Picking "Unassigned" from the dropdown clears it.”
  • S1-R7: “With nobody assigned, the field reads "Unassigned".”
  • S1-R9: “The option for the person in the field is checked. With nobody assigned, "Unassigned" is checked.”
  • S1-R14: “Each change is saved as it is made. There is no Save button.”
